name: KJ's Neighborhood Bar
bio: KJ's Neighborhood Bar is a bar on East Main Street in downtown Ventura with live music, karaoke, DJs and special events. It hosts karaoke on Wednesday and Friday nights.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from @kjs_neighborhoodbar, its Facebook and @venturakaraoke.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
